nodes.summary: Treat layerwise, key/value, RoPE-aware, and hardware-aware KV bit allocation as experiments until reproduced in MLX. Validation gate: MLX implementation Rollback: no quality advantage over uniform KV quantization
nodes.title: adaptive kv quantization

nodes.summary: Cache repeated reference/ICL conditioning only with model/codec/quantization/speaker fingerprint keys. Validation gate: cold/warm parity Rollback: speaker identity or prosody drifts
nodes.title: Audio reference / ICL conditioning cache

nodes.summary: Use cache-aware streaming, overlap-add, and chunked codec/vocoder execution only when chunk boundaries preserve audio quality. Validation gate: first-audio latency Rollback: audible discontinuity
nodes.title: audio streaming and cache

nodes.summary: Cast a controlled F32 MLX port to BF16 only when the exact target workload retains its declared quality window; keep timing results observation-only until every promotion gate, including external signed attestation, passes. Validation gate: deterministic F32-to-BF16 conversion manifest Rollback: quality output leaves the declared window Observed source band 1.0x-1.8122x on metric wall-time; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: bf16 weight cast

nodes.summary: For repeated-block models that exceed unified memory, stream block weights from inspectable safetensors into a shared block only after eager parity is established. Validation gate: block key coverage Rollback: streamed outputs drift
nodes.title: Repeated-block weight streaming

nodes.summary: Require namespace isolation, opt-out, padding/constant-time policy review, and leakage tests before cross-user cache reuse. Validation gate: tenant namespace tests Rollback: unbounded cross-tenant reuse
nodes.title: cache privacy and isolation

nodes.summary: Compile pure repeated regions after parity is established and shapes/state containers are stable. Validation gate: compile count or cold/warm timing captured Rollback: hidden retracing
nodes.title: compile stable region

nodes.summary: Superseded by multimodal-content-prefix-cache; do not count this alias as a separate optimization or evidence line. Validation gate: same-image/different-encoding hit tests Rollback: false cache hit
nodes.title: content prefix cache vlm

nodes.summary: Use only for concurrent serving where scheduler complexity is justified. Validation gate: concurrency=1 and many Rollback: tail latency regression Observed source band 1.0x-4.3x on metric batch-throughput; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: continuous batching serving

nodes.summary: Do not port. CUDA Graphs capture/replay is NVIDIA-specific; the portable MLX analog is mx.compile of the single decode step, which this skill already recommends. Validation gate: Not applicable on Metal/MLX; use the mx.compile stable-region gate instead. Rollback: Always: this method is rejected for MLX and must not be adopted.
nodes.title: CUDA Graphs decode-loop capture

nodes.summary: Try only when a compatible smaller draft model shares tokenizer/vocabulary and acceptance is high enough to offset draft cost. Validation gate: lossless distribution or quality-preserving test Rollback: acceptance too low Observed source band 1.0x-1.3x on metric decode-tokens-per-sec; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: draft model speculation

nodes.summary: Use only when compatible trained drafter heads/artifacts and verification code exist for the target architecture. Validation gate: drafter compatibility Rollback: incompatible features
nodes.title: eagle medusa mtp drafters

nodes.summary: Try MLX fast SDPA when Q/K/V layout, GQA/MQA grouping, mask, scale, causal alignment, sinks, and dtype semantics match the source. Validation gate: Prefill tensor parity Rollback: Any semantic mismatch
nodes.title: MLX fast scaled-dot-product attention

nodes.summary: Keep generic audio prefix cache as a research experiment until a model-specific MLX-Audio cache path exists. Validation gate: model-specific cache path Rollback: state mismatch
nodes.title: Generic audio prefix cache

nodes.summary: Move host synchronization to intentional boundaries and avoid accidental NumPy conversion, printing, or scalar item extraction in hot loops. Validation gate: same outputs Rollback: memory blow-up
nodes.title: Deliberate lazy evaluation boundaries

nodes.summary: After a loop oracle passes, move to MLX gather_mm/gather_qmm expert dispatch and quantize experts only after sensitivity tests. Validation gate: loop oracle parity Rollback: rare-expert quality regression
nodes.title: moe expert dispatch and quantization

nodes.summary: Treat fused MoE gate/up projection as an experimental patch, not baseline MLX support. Validation gate: token-exact parity Rollback: proposal not available in target runtime
nodes.title: MoE gate/up projection fusion

nodes.summary: Use gather or grouped matmul primitives when expert routing creates large enough grouped matrix multiplies and duplicate/scatter semantics match. Validation gate: loop oracle parity including duplicates Rollback: small group overhead dominates
nodes.title: moe gather and expert batching

nodes.summary: Use a media-aware block prefix cache only when restored cache coverage and media placeholder safety are proven. Validation gate: media extra hashes include content and processing knobs Rollback: tenant isolation fails Observed source band 1.0x-28.0x on metric repeated-media-ttft; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: multimodal content prefix cache

nodes.summary: Use MLX affine, mxfp4, mxfp8, or nvfp4 only where the target Linear path and conversion tooling support the mode. Validation gate: task quality against unquantized baseline Rollback: quality drift exceeds budget Observed source band 1.0x-2.4x on metric decode-tokens-per-sec; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: native low bit weight quantization

nodes.summary: Consider as a low-memory experiment for copy-heavy workloads only after implementing a target MLX drafter. Validation gate: hit rate Rollback: low match rate
nodes.title: prompt lookup ngram speculation

nodes.summary: Reuse immutable prefix state only when model, tokenizer/template, processor, adapter, quantization, positions, and cache format version match. Validation gate: exact-hit and miss tests Rollback: incorrect reuse Observed source band 1.0x-23.8x on metric ttft-proxy; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: prompt prefix cache

nodes.summary: Use Qwen3-TTS batch_generate for compatible concurrent TTS jobs after single-request quality is locked. Validation gate: single-vs-batched parity Rollback: TTFB or P95 tail violates budget Observed source band 1.0x-5.45x on metric batch-throughput; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: Qwen3-TTS batch generation

nodes.summary: Use only when the source model actually depends on PyTorch grid_sample-style spatial or volume warping; first lock a readable MLX/NumPy reference, then consider a custom Metal kernel for the profiled warp. Validation gate: coordinate order and align_corners parity Rollback: unsupported source grid_sample mode is required Observed source band 1.0x-10.0x on metric kernel-latency; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: spatial grid sample kernel

nodes.summary: Start with official/proven uniform KV quantization before adaptive or rotated KV schemes. Validation gate: logit/perplexity drift over context lengths Rollback: quality regression Observed source band 1.0x-1.1x on metric decode-tokens-per-sec; the repository holds this claim (promotion_state=withheld) and emits no effective range.
nodes.title: uniform kv quantization

nodes.summary: Treat FPS/frame/pixel budgets as an explicit quality mode for video VLMs. Validation gate: visual token count recorded Rollback: quality drops beyond budget
nodes.title: Video FPS/frame/pixel input budgeting

nodes.summary: Use for repeated identical image/video inputs after keying by content hash and processor/projector revision. Validation gate: cold/warm logits parity Rollback: warm outputs drift from cold outputs
nodes.title: Projected vision feature cache

nodes.summary: Do not recommend generic visual-token pruning unless the model-specific MLX implementation and quality probes exist. Validation gate: MLX implementation path Rollback: quality regression
nodes.title: Generic visual-token pruning or merging
